description: Na₃La(BO₃)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.40 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.73 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.72 Å. La is bonded to eight O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing LaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.58 Å. There are two inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.37-1.41 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.39 Å) and one longer (1.41 Å) B-O bond length. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one La, and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Na, two equivalent La, and one B atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na, one La, and one B atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one La, and one B atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Na, two equivalent La, and one B atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂La₂B trigonal bipyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na, one La, and one B atom.
